summary: Physics change request of ls::PhysicsRequestSystem, applied by ls::PhysicsLoaderSystem and phx::PhysXDisableSimulationSystem: the system drains its queue of Variant<Unload, ReloadResourceID, ReloadPath, ChangeGroupMaskAndFlags> (macOS ls::MPMCQueueBounded<...>) into a HashMap<EntityHandle, PhysicsModificationOneFrameComponent> (macOS name) and adds one component per entity. The registry does not flag it one-frame. Never seen alive.
